title: secretx: bypass in config validate() is correct design
description: In both smtp/src/config.rs and reader/src/config.rs, the DKIM key_seed_b64 base64 validation is skipped when the value starts with 'secretx:'. This is correct: validate() runs before secretx resolution (which is async and happens in main()), so decoding a secretx URI as base64 would always fail. The secretx URI is validated at config load (from_uri() call in main()) and the resolved bytes are validated at key construction time. The asymmetry (public_key_b64 is always validated, key_seed_b64 is conditionally skipped) is intentional and correct — public_key_b64 is not expected to come from a secret store. A future contributor might 'fix' the asymmetry by also skipping public_key_b64 validation, which would be wrong.
